title: Forms and personal details (Formulare)
summary: Fill in a form with your personal details, and answer the same questions when someone asks them: name, date and place of birth, nationality, marital status.
goals: Understand the fields of a German form
Fill in a form and sign it
Answer questions about your personal details
Know what Anmeldung means in Germany

nicosWeg.title: Nicos Weg A1, chapter 2: Contact details

sections.title: Filling it in
sections.text:
- [[Bitte füllen Sie das Formular aus.]] [[ausfüllen]] is separable (Unit 3).
- [[Bitte unterschreiben Sie hier.]] = Please sign here (the imperative, Unit 5).
- [[Hier fehlt noch die Unterschrift.]] = The signature is still missing here.

The same questions come up in conversation (Units 1-3):
- [[Wie ist Ihr Familienname?]]
- [[Wo sind Sie geboren?]] - [[In Jerewan.]]
- [[Wann sind Sie geboren?]] - [[Am zwölften März neunzehnhundertneunundneunzig.]]
- [[Sind Sie verheiratet?]] - [[Nein, ich bin ledig.]]
- [[Wie alt sind Sie?]] On forms this is [[Alter]] (age).

sections.title: Anmeldung
sections.text: After you move into a flat in Germany, you have two weeks to register your address: [[die Anmeldung]]. In Munich you do it at a Bürgerbüro. Take your passport ([[der Pass]]; EU citizens can use their ID card, [[der Ausweis]]) and the confirmation from your landlord: [[Ich möchte meine Adresse anmelden.]] [[Anmeldung]] also means the reception desk, at a doctor's for example.

sections.title: Home and abroad
sections.text:
- [[der Ausländer]], [[die Ausländerin]] = foreigner
- [[im Ausland]] = abroad: [[Meine Schwester arbeitet im Ausland.]]
- [[die Heimat]] = home country, the place you come from: [[Meine Heimat ist Armenien.]]
- [[Ich brauche eine Information.]] Ask at [[die Auskunft]] (the information desk).
- [[zum Beispiel]] = for example

items.question: A form asks for your 'Geburtsort'. What do you write?
items.explanation: der Geburtsort = place of birth (der Ort = the place).

items.question: What does the field 'Familienstand' ask about?
items.explanation: der Familienstand = marital status: ledig (single), verheiratet (married).
